text:
jin: Heads-up: Petra-Lite model card and the model_support CSV landed with different key names for the quantized profile. CSV has `quant_profile`, code/docs expect `quantization_profile`. SDK integration tests are failing.

sara: ouch. which PR added it?

jin: PR 1048 (model catalog add). Local test failure: 
```
KeyError: 'quantization_profile' in model_card.examples[0]
Present keys: name,family,quant_profile,seq_limit
```

dan: Seems like a straightforward rename but let's be safe. We should accept both for one release and publish a short migration note.

natalie: I'll take docs fixes. Plan: 1) update CSV to `quantization_profile`, 2) update the model card snippets, 3) add migration blurb in catalog, 4) add an example showing legacy+new key so teams can mirror behavior. I'll push a patch.

alex: SDK update: added tolerance in sdk-go to fallback to `quant_profile` and emit a deprecation log. I'll submit a tiny tests PR asserting both keys are parsed.

sara: Also while editing the Petra-Lite card, we should correct the sequence guidance. The bench in PR suggests 8k but quantized runs on low-memory devices behave closer to ~4k because of reduced KV cache. We should make that explicit.

jin: Agreed. Proposed wording: "Quantized Petra-Lite variants use a smaller KV cache; on small GPUs expect ~4096 tokens. For sustained long-context, prefer non-quantized or extended-KV variants." Keep it short.

natalie: Adding that plus a link to the quantization guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/optimize/quantization-guide and a reproducible bench command.

natalie: bench snippet to add: 
```
# run quick perf check
python tools/bench.py --model=petra-lite-q --seq=4096 --batch=1
```

dan: Good. Also add a short note in the model catalog changelog and a deprecation line in release highlights.

sara: I'll add the changelog line: "Field `quant_profile` deprecated; migrate to `quantization_profile`. Backwards-compat accepted for one release."

docs-bot: Reminder: bump model card frontmatter version and add a models/CHANGELOG.md entry or lint will fail.

natalie: Pushed docs PR 1055: updates CSV, card snippets, Limits note, migration example, and canonical guide link. Fixed a bad redirect in the guide link while I was there.

alex: SDK PR 331 opened with fallback+deprecation tests. CI green.

jin: Running integration tests locally against PR 331+1055.

alex: One small CI nit: docs link-checker flagged an internal anchor on the Optimize guide. Fixed in PR 1055.

dan: After merges: update benchmarks page with corrected Petra-Lite numbers and call out the quantized tradeoff. I'll coordinate a short blurb for release notes.

sara: Nice teamwork. Once both PRs are merged, I'll add the release highlight and drop a short banner for users who recently accessed Petra-Lite.

jin: Thanks all — this kept the SDK tests from regressing in CI. :+1:
